brief.thesis: quantmechanica.com exists to make one claim credible to strangers — that QuantMechanica builds mechanical strategies and proves them on real data with no cherry-picking — so that the copy-trading accounts, MQL5 Marketplace EAs and Darwinex Zero fund it intends to advertise later are believed. The trust engine is the Strategy Archive (OWNER: 'das eigentliche Herzstueck'), a public pass/fail record of 3,378 evaluations sitting on an evidence-first pipeline told as three phases: Validation (Q00-Q08), Optimization & Requalification (Q09-Q14), Book build & live (Q15-Q17). The refresh under-delivers four ways and this brief corrects all four: (1) re-centre and dignify the archive as a public good rather than a utilitarian table; (2) phase-ify the pipeline with per-gate 'what it checks / what fails it' lines and explain the frozen baseline, the terminal Q14 KEEP_INCUMBENT outcome, and the fail-closed book trigger that is the honest reason almost nothing is live; (3) add an honest 'What we're building' roadmap so every future channel reads as planned-and-gated-by-evidence; (4) strip or reframe every unsupported number and fabricated live result (performance overclaims, two funded-account blog narratives, per-strategy Profit Factors, the invented $20/lot Q06 commission, the ~38 survivors figure) to the true state — live book in monitored burn-in, Myfxbook verification pending, 21 qualified candidates, 9 confirmed on full history, no funded account yet. Two OWNER-named mechanical fixes gate everything: the extensionless-link 404s ('kein Link funktioniert') and the oversized gap above Market Structure, plus a restored contact + newsletter closing section on the homepage. Read-only phase: propose, do not edit.
positioning_lines: The Strategy Archive is the product — a public, no-cherry-picking record of every strategy and how far it got — and every other surface exists to make it credible.

The pipeline is told as three plain-English phases everywhere on the site — Validation (Q00-Q08), Optimization & Requalification (Q09-Q14), Book build & live (Q15-Q17) — and each gate carries one line of what it checks and one line of what fails it.

Almost nothing is live by design: Phase 3 opens only through the fail-closed book trigger (a critical mass of qualified survivors plus a signed OWNER book order), and that scarcity is the honesty headline, not a disclaimer.

Every future channel — Darwinex Zero allocation, FTMO-style prop challenges, MQL5 Marketplace EAs, copy-trading/signals — appears only as 'planned, gated by evidence', so it can be advertised plausibly once the pipeline earns it.

Every number traces to a public-data key via a data-stat hook or equals today's value under a 'measured <date>' caption; no invented commissions, no per-strategy metrics, no fabricated live results — evidence over claims is the product, not a slogan.

One honest current state repeated on every page: live book in monitored burn-in, Myfxbook verification in progress, 21 qualified candidates in the pool, 9 confirmed on full history, no funded account yet.

Two populations are labelled apart and never mixed: the pipeline funnel counts distinct strategy-symbol pairs from stats.json; the archive funnel/attrition counts cards derived live from strategy-archive.json.

pipeline_phases.title: Phase 1 · Validation — the strategy proves itself (Q00-Q08)
pipeline_phases.one_line: A cited, machine-learning-free idea becomes a compiling EA, then must show a repeatable, cost-robust, statistically defensible edge on real tick data — ending in a frozen, target-neutral baseline.
pipeline_phases.what_it_proves: A real, cost-aware edge that generalises out-of-sample and survives regimes, execution noise and an eleven-part statistical battery. Two intake gates (Q00-Q01) admit a candidate; seven automated evidence gates (Q02-Q08) decide it. Not 'nine automated gates'.

gate_lines.name: Research Intake
gate_lines.line: Checks that a strategy idea has a real, citable source, is mechanical, is testable on our instruments, and uses no machine learning.
gate_lines.fails_when: No verifiable source, purely discretionary rules, untestable on our instruments, or relies on machine learning.

gate_lines.name: Build & Spec
gate_lines.line: Turns the idea into a deterministic Expert Advisor that compiles and trades, with a complete written specification.
gate_lines.fails_when: The EA fails to compile, produces no smoke trade, or ships without a complete specification.

gate_lines.name: Baseline Screening
gate_lines.line: Screens each market for a profitable, active baseline signal on in-sample history before any deeper testing.
gate_lines.fails_when: Below the profit-factor, drawdown, or minimum-trade floor on a symbol — that pair stops here.

gate_lines.name: Parameter Sweep
gate_lines.line: Tests whether the result holds across a stable band of settings, not just one tuned value.
gate_lines.fails_when: Too few grid settings stay profitable, or no wide-enough stable parameter plateau exists.

gate_lines.name: Walk-Forward + Commission
gate_lines.line: Runs anchored walk-forward on unseen out-of-sample years with realistic ECN commission applied.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any out-of-sample year loses money once commission is charged, or in-sample data leaked.

gate_lines.name: Gross Full-History Robustness
gate_lines.line: Replays the robust settings across the entire available history to see if the edge survives every regime.
gate_lines.fails_when: Full-history profit factor falls below break-even, drawdown exceeds the ceiling, or too few trades.

gate_lines.name: Stress HARSH
gate_lines.line: Randomly rejects a share of trades (seeded 10% rejection) to test whether the edge survives disrupted, imperfect execution.
gate_lines.fails_when: Post-stress profit factor falls below break-even, drawdown breaches the ceiling, or trades fall under the floor.

gate_lines.name: Multi-Seed
gate_lines.line: Repeats the run across five random seeds to separate a real signal from lucky execution ordering.
gate_lines.fails_when: Profit-factor spread across seeds is too wide, or any single seed turns unprofitable.

gate_lines.name: Davey Statistical Validation
gate_lines.line: Runs eleven statistical and robustness checks to produce a frozen, target-neutral evidence dossier.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any one of the eleven sub-checks fails — correlation, deflated Sharpe, overfitting, decay, seasonality, and more.

pipeline_phases.title: Phase 2 · Optimization & Requalification (Q09-Q14)
pipeline_phases.one_line: The frozen baseline is confirmed under live-like conditions, a news/venue configuration is sealed, and any re-optimised challenger must beat both baseline and incumbent — or the incumbent is kept. Terminal at Q14.
pipeline_phases.what_it_proves: A sealed news/venue configuration and a full-history-confirmed incumbent, plus the discipline that a re-optimised challenger is promoted only if it genuinely beats both baseline and incumbent. KEEP_INCUMBENT is a valid, common terminal result — we do not change a strategy just to look busy.

gate_lines.name: Baseline Full Run
gate_lines.line: Freezes a full-history, pre-news baseline as the fixed reference for the later sealed comparison.
gate_lines.fails_when: No hash-bound baseline can be reused or reproduced; the reference is never inferred from a verdict.

gate_lines.name: News Impact + FTMO Recommendation
gate_lines.line: Compares news-handling and venue-compliance settings across two axes, then seals one locked configuration for the two programs we target — Darwinex Zero and FTMO-style prop challenges.
gate_lines.fails_when: The A/B evidence is invalid or ambiguous, so no configuration can be locked.

gate_lines.name: Incumbent Full-History Confirmation
gate_lines.line: Re-confirms the locked configuration over each symbol's full available history with realistic costs.
gate_lines.fails_when: With the locked news configuration, profit factor falls below break-even or drawdown breaches the ceiling.

gate_lines.name: Pattern Filter Selection
gate_lines.line: Considers a small, preregistered set of pattern filters; selecting none is a valid outcome.
gate_lines.fails_when: Nothing kills a strategy here — zero admissible filters is a valid pass-through, not a failure.

gate_lines.name: Parameter Optimization & Freeze
gate_lines.line: Re-optimises parameters on development data only, then freezes the result as a new challenger identity.
gate_lines.fails_when: The frozen challenger cannot clear its own fresh Q02-Q11 cascade as a new EA.

gate_lines.name: Best-Settings Head-to-Head + Holdout
gate_lines.line: Compares the frozen challenger against its baseline and incumbent on sealed out-of-sample and holdout windows; keeping the incumbent is a valid terminal result.
gate_lines.fails_when: Challenger does not beat both baseline and incumbent; it is not promoted, the incumbent stays.

pipeline_phases.title: Phase 3 · Book build & live readiness (Q15-Q17)
pipeline_phases.one_line: Survivors are judged as members of a correlation-capped book, cleared operationally, and watched in a monitored live burn-in — entered only through the fail-closed book trigger, which is why very few strategies are ever live at once.
pipeline_phases.what_it_proves: That a candidate belongs in a correlation-capped book and behaves live as it did in backtest. Entry is fail-closed: at least 25 qualified candidates plus a signed OWNER book order (the exact 25 threshold is an internal criterion — surface it only with OWNER sign-off, otherwise keep it qualitative).

gate_lines.name: Final Portfolio Construction
gate_lines.line: Admits survivors as portfolio members under correlation, family and symbol caps; entered only via the book trigger.
gate_lines.fails_when: Correlation too high, or family or symbol caps exceeded — the candidate is not admitted.

gate_lines.name: Operational Readiness
gate_lines.line: Runs the operational pre-flight — fresh compile, setfile, risk mode, timezone and kill-switch — before any live step.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any pre-flight check fails; deployment stays blocked until it is fixed and re-run.

gate_lines.name: Live Burn-In DXZ
gate_lines.line: Observes the strategy for at least fourteen days on the live Darwinex Zero account under monitoring and a kill-switch, before any scaling.
gate_lines.fails_when: Live behaviour diverges from the backtest or trips the kill-switch during the monitored burn-in.

phases.title: Intake & Build
phases.one_line: Vault Macrophase 1 (proof of edge) opens: a cited, mechanical idea becomes a compiling, testable Expert Advisor.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves the idea is legitimate, mechanical and machine-learning-free, and now exists as a deterministic EA with a complete spec. Kills: no real source, discretionary rules, or any ML (Q00); no compile, no smoke trade, or no spec doc (Q01).

gate_lines.name: Research Intake
gate_lines.line: Checks that a strategy idea has a real, citable source, is mechanical, is testable on our instruments, and uses no machine learning.
gate_lines.fails_when: No verifiable source, purely discretionary rules, untestable on our instruments, or relies on machine learning.

gate_lines.name: Build & Spec
gate_lines.line: Turns the idea into a deterministic Expert Advisor that compiles and trades, with a complete written specification.
gate_lines.fails_when: The EA fails to compile, produces no smoke trade, or ships without a complete specification.

phases.title: Baseline & Walk-Forward Validation
phases.one_line: Still Macrophase 1: the signal must be profitable in-sample, stable across settings, and hold on unseen years after commission.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves a real, cost-aware edge that generalises out-of-sample, judged per (EA, symbol) pair. Kills: below profit-factor / drawdown / minimum-trade floors (Q02); no stable parameter plateau (Q03); any out-of-sample fold unprofitable after commission, or in-sample data leaked (Q04).

gate_lines.name: Baseline Screening
gate_lines.line: Screens each market for a profitable, active baseline signal on in-sample history before any deeper testing.
gate_lines.fails_when: Below the profit-factor, drawdown, or minimum-trade floor on a symbol — that pair stops here.

gate_lines.name: Parameter Sweep
gate_lines.line: Tests whether the result holds across a stable band of settings, not just one tuned value.
gate_lines.fails_when: Too few grid settings stay profitable, or no wide-enough stable parameter plateau exists.

gate_lines.name: Walk-Forward + Commission
gate_lines.line: Runs anchored walk-forward on unseen out-of-sample years with realistic ECN commission applied.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any out-of-sample year loses money once commission is charged, or in-sample data leaked.

phases.title: Robustness & Statistics
phases.one_line: Macrophase 1 closes: the edge is stress-tested across full history, execution noise, random seeds and an eleven-part statistical battery.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves the edge holds across market regimes and survives statistics, ending in a frozen, target-neutral baseline. Kills: full-history break-even or drawdown breach (Q05); breakdown under seeded trade rejection (Q06); seed instability (Q07); any of eleven Davey sub-gates (Q08).

gate_lines.name: Gross Full-History Robustness
gate_lines.line: Replays the robust settings across the entire available history to see if the edge survives every regime.
gate_lines.fails_when: Full-history profit factor falls below break-even, drawdown exceeds the ceiling, or too few trades.

gate_lines.name: Stress HARSH
gate_lines.line: Randomly rejects a share of trades to test whether the edge survives disrupted, imperfect execution.
gate_lines.fails_when: Profit factor falls below break-even, drawdown breaches the ceiling, or trades fall under the floor.

gate_lines.name: Multi-Seed
gate_lines.line: Repeats the run across five random seeds to separate a real signal from lucky execution ordering.
gate_lines.fails_when: Profit-factor spread across seeds is too wide, or any single seed turns unprofitable.

gate_lines.name: Davey Statistical Validation
gate_lines.line: Runs eleven statistical and robustness checks to produce a frozen, target-neutral evidence dossier.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any one of the eleven sub-checks fails — correlation, deflated Sharpe, overfitting, decay, seasonality, and more.

phases.title: News & Requalification
phases.one_line: Macrophase 2 (optimisation & requalification) begins: a pre-news reference is fixed, a news/venue config is locked, and the incumbent is re-confirmed.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves a sealed configuration choice and a full-history-confirmed incumbent per symbol. Kills: no reproducible baseline (Q09); invalid or ambiguous A/B news evidence (Q10); break-even or drawdown breach with the locked config (Q11).

gate_lines.name: Baseline Full Run
gate_lines.line: Freezes a full-history, pre-news baseline as the fixed reference for the later sealed comparison.
gate_lines.fails_when: No hash-bound baseline can be reused or reproduced; the reference is never inferred from a verdict.

gate_lines.name: News Impact + FTMO Recommendation
gate_lines.line: Compares news-handling and venue-compliance settings across two axes, then seals one locked configuration recommendation.
gate_lines.fails_when: The A/B evidence is invalid or ambiguous, so no configuration can be locked.

gate_lines.name: Incumbent Full-History Confirmation
gate_lines.line: Re-confirms the locked configuration over each symbol's full available history with realistic costs.
gate_lines.fails_when: With the locked news configuration, profit factor falls below break-even or drawdown breaches the ceiling.

phases.title: Optimisation Branch
phases.one_line: Macrophase 2 ends (terminal): preregistered filters and re-optimised parameters produce a challenger that must beat baseline and incumbent — or the incumbent is kept.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves any change is a genuine improvement, not overfitting; KEEP_INCUMBENT is a valid terminal result. Kills: challenger fails its own fresh Q02-Q11 cascade (Q13); challenger fails to beat baseline and incumbent (Q14). Q12 never kills — zero filters is a valid pass-through.

gate_lines.name: Pattern Filter Selection
gate_lines.line: Considers a small, preregistered set of pattern filters; selecting none is a valid outcome.
gate_lines.fails_when: Nothing kills a strategy here — zero admissible filters is a valid pass-through, not a failure.

gate_lines.name: Parameter Optimization & Freeze
gate_lines.line: Re-optimises parameters on development data only, then freezes the result as a new challenger identity.
gate_lines.fails_when: The frozen challenger cannot clear its own fresh Q02-Q11 cascade as a new EA.

gate_lines.name: Best-Settings Head-to-Head + Holdout
gate_lines.line: Compares the frozen challenger against its baseline and incumbent on sealed out-of-sample and holdout windows.
gate_lines.fails_when: Challenger does not beat both baseline and incumbent; it is not promoted, the incumbent stays.

phases.title: Portfolio & Live Burn-In
phases.one_line: Macrophase 3 (book build): survivors are judged as a portfolio, cleared operationally, and watched in a live burn-in — entered only via the fail-closed book trigger.
phases.what_it_proves: Proves a candidate belongs in a correlation-capped book and behaves live as it did in backtest. Entry is fail-closed: at least 25 qualified candidates plus a signed OWNER book order. Kills: correlation or cap violation (Q15); any failed pre-flight check (Q16); kill-switch trip or divergence in burn-in (Q17).

gate_lines.name: Final Portfolio Construction
gate_lines.line: Admits survivors as portfolio members under correlation, family and symbol caps; entered only via the book trigger.
gate_lines.fails_when: Correlation too high, or family or symbol caps exceeded — the candidate is not admitted.

gate_lines.name: Operational Readiness
gate_lines.line: Runs the operational pre-flight — fresh compile, setfile, risk mode, timezone and kill-switch — before any live step.
gate_lines.fails_when: Any pre-flight check fails; deployment stays blocked until it is fixed and re-run.

gate_lines.name: Live Burn-In DXZ
gate_lines.line: Observes the strategy for at least fourteen days on the live Darwinex Zero account under monitoring and a kill-switch.
gate_lines.fails_when: Live behaviour diverges from the backtest or trips the kill-switch during the monitored burn-in.

Static funnel fallback '7,020' does not equal stats.json q02_baseline_pass (7,021).

proposed_changes.section: The 18 gates in three stage groups — stage labels
proposed_changes.spec: Rename the three stage labels to name the phases the way OWNER frames them, keeping canonical gate names underneath. Stage 1 label -> 'Phase 1 · Validation — the strategy proves itself (Q00-Q08)'. Stage 2 -> 'Phase 2 · Optimisation & requalification (Q09-Q14)'. Stage 3 -> 'Phase 3 · Book build & live readiness (Q15-Q17)'. This mirrors the canonical Makrophasen 1/2/3 and OWNER's 'Validierung, Optimierung, Buch Build'.

Expand each one-line intro into 2-3 sentences that explain the phase's purpose AND its terminal concept. Phase 1: 'Seven automated evidence gates behind two intake gates. A strategy either produces a repeatable, cost-robust, statistically defensible signal on real tick data, or it is retired. Phase 1 ends in a frozen, target-neutral baseline — the reference everything after is measured against.' Phase 2: 'The frozen baseline is confirmed under live-like conditions, news-handling modes are compared, and any optimisation must beat the incumbent in a sealed, out-of-sample head-to-head. Phase 2 is terminal at Q14: keeping the existing configuration is a valid, common outcome — we do not change a strategy just to look busy.' Phase 3: 'Survivors are judged as members of a portfolio, not as individuals — correlation, tail behaviour and marginal contribution — then pass an operational pre-flight and a monitored live burn-in on the live account. Phase 3 opens only through a deliberate gate (see below), which is why very few strategies are ever live at once.'

proposed_changes.section: NEW callout — 'Why Phase 3 rarely opens' / the book trigger (after Stage 3)
proposed_changes.spec: Add a short .panel--flat callout that turns the low live count into the honest headline. Draft: eyebrow 'By design' -> 'Most strategies never reach live — and that is the point.' Body: 'Phase 3 does not open one strategy at a time. It opens only when a critical mass of qualified survivors exists AND the owner authorises building a book. Until then, confirmed strategies wait. Today the pipeline has 21 qualified candidates in the pool.' (If OWNER approves surfacing the exact threshold, append 'toward a book minimum of 25.' — the 25 figure is an internal criterion; present it only with OWNER sign-off, otherwise keep it qualitative.) No live claim, no date promise.

Fix the mislabel. Keep data-stat 'portfolio_candidates' (21) but change the caption from 'Q10 confirmed' to 'Portfolio candidates' with sub-caption 'distinct pairs confirmed on full history, measured <date>'. Add one clarifying line about the unit. Draft: 'Around 4,801 compiled strategies enter. Because one strategy is tested on many instruments, the field is measured in distinct strategy-symbol pairs from here on. Four evidence gates narrow it from thousands of pairs to the handful confirmed on full history.' Update the static fallback 4,799 -> 4,801.

Correct to: 'Two intake gates and seven automated evidence gates. Research intake and build/spec admit a candidate; Q02-Q08 then decide, on real broker tick data, whether it produces a repeatable, cost-robust, statistically defensible signal — or is retired.'

proposed_changes.section: Gate cards — Q10 and Q17 plain-language gloss
proposed_changes.spec: Keep the canonical names but make the venue terms legible. Q10 desc append: '... and issues the venue recommendation for the two trading programs we target (Darwinex Zero and FTMO-style prop challenges).' pages.current_message: Hero 'Every strategy we test, including the failures.' 4 KPI figures (3,378 evaluated / 9 passed Q10 / 1,297 retired / 18 gates), then a filterable, paginated table of every card's gate journey (public_id, Q00->Q17 coverage strip, terminal gate, pass/fail verdict) with expandable per-row gate-journey detail. problems: This is 'das eigentliche Herzstueck' per OWNER, but it reads as a utilitarian data table with a thin hero. Nothing frames why this archive is significant, how to read a gate journey, or why it deliberately carries no per-strategy metrics (an honesty choice, not a limitation). A first-time visitor gets a spreadsheet, not the heart of the company.

The stage-filter chips use a band mapping that contradicts both the pipeline page and the canonical phases: JS BANDS are intake Q00-Q03, baseline Q04-Q08, robustness Q09-Q10, portfolio Q11-Q13, optimization Q14-Q17. Canonical macrophases are Q00-Q08 / Q09-Q14 / Q15-Q17. So 'Portfolio' here means Q11-Q13 (actually Phase-2 confirmation/optimization gates) and 'Optimization' means Q14-Q17 (which includes the live/book gates). The vocabulary is inconsistent across the site.

'Passed Q10 full history' / chip 'Passed Q10+': under v4 Q10 is News Impact, and full-history confirmation is Q11. The survivor label attaches 'full history' to the wrong gate. archive_passed_q10=9 happens to equal Q11 PASS=9, but the label misdescribes the gate's meaning.

KPI 'Retired on a failed gate' = archive_failed = 1,297 (stats.json), but the served archive contains 1,298 items with at least one FAIL. Off-by-one between the headline stat and the data the page itself renders.

No distribution view. The single most compelling, fully-disclosure-compliant artefact the archive can show — a count of how many strategies died at each gate (Q02 611, Q04 440, Q08 112, Q05 68, Q03 37, ...) — is not surfaced. The template renders optional 'Mechanism' and 'Family' fields, but the archive JSON carries neither (only public_id + gate_coverage). Harmless, but it means the promised 'families if present' is currently always absent — worth stating plainly rather than implying richer data exists.

proposed_changes.spec: Reposition the archive as a public contribution, not a table. Keep the headline, strengthen the lead. Draft lead: 'This is the complete, public record of every mechanical strategy QuantMechanica has put through its gate pipeline — 3,378 evaluations, the handful that survive full-history confirmation and the far larger number that do not. We show how far each got and where it died. We do not cherry-pick, and we do not hide the failures — publishing them is the point.' Add a secondary line positioning it as the heart: 'Most shops show you their winners. This is the whole tape.'

proposed_changes.section: NEW explainer panel — 'How to read this archive' (between KPI section and the table)
proposed_changes.spec: Add a .panel--flat that teaches the visitor to read a gate journey and states the disclosure choice honestly. proposed_changes.section: NEW figure — 'Where strategies die' attrition-by-gate (after the explainer, before the table)

Values today: Q02 611, Q04 440, Q08 112, Q05 68, Q03 37, Q07 24, Q06 4, Q12 1, Q09 1. Render with the existing chart module or a simple horizontal .figure-bar list. Caption: 'Count of strategies retired at each gate · terminal fails only, no metrics · measured <date>.' Source these counts from a new additive key in stats.json or compute client-side from strategy-archive.json (the page already loads it). Add a small named CSS rule .attrition-bar{...} rather than restyling shared components.

proposed_changes.section: Stage filter chips + JS BANDS mapping
proposed_changes.spec: Re-map the stage bands to the canonical three phases so the vocabulary matches the pipeline page and Vault. Replace the 5 ad-hoc bands with 3 phase chips: 'Validation Q00-Q08', 'Optimization Q09-Q14', 'Book build Q15-Q17' (BANDS: validation lo0 hi8, optimization lo9 hi14, bookbuild lo15 hi17). pages.current_message: Hero 'Live, and independently verified.' 'Every deployed strategy is tracked in real time... published by Myfxbook, an independent third-party audit, not by us.' A dark panel with a Myfxbook widget (portfolio 'darwineexzero-demo'), three figures (18 gates / 10-15 EAs in the live sleeve / <2% reaches live), and governance prose about T_Live isolation and OWNER-only AutoTrading.

Business Model: the live book is in burn-in/build-up, 'noch keine Challenge gekauft', Myfxbook integration 'zu verifizieren'. The hero asserts 'Live, and independently verified' and 'Every deployed strategy is tracked in real time' — on a build-in-public site this is the most credibility-damaging overclaim on the site.

'<2% of everything we build reaches live deployment — measured 2026-09-02': nothing has reached live deployment (burn-in only), so 'reaches live deployment' projects a state that is not established. '<2% clear the full validation pipeline' is defensible; 'reaches live deployment' is not.

The embedded Myfxbook portfolio is slugged 'darwineexzero-demo' / titled 'DarwineexZero Demo' — a demo/burn-in track presented as 'live independently-verified deployed portfolio'. Either it is a demo (then 'live' is wrong) or a real burn-in account (then say so and state verification status).
Governance prose is accurate and strong (T_Live isolation, OWNER-only AutoTrading) — keep it; it is the honest core the rest of the page should match.

proposed_changes.spec: Reframe to the true state: an early, transparently-tracked live book in burn-in, verification in progress. Draft eyebrow 'Live burn-in' -> heading 'Going live, in the open.' Lead: 'Our first live book is in a monitored burn-in on Darwinex Zero. We are building an independently verifiable track record on Myfxbook — it is early, and we will show it as it grows rather than wait for a flattering start.' CTA label 'Open the live dashboard' (only if the linked account is genuinely the burn-in account; if it is a demo, label it 'Open the burn-in dashboard (demo/early)').

Replace the two overclaiming figures with supportable ones. Keep '18 validation gates every strategy clears before it can go live'. Replace '10-15 EAs in the live sleeve (measured)' with a TARGET framed as a target: figure '10-15' caption 'target portfolio size once the first book is built (not yet live)' — remove the 'measured <date>' date on it, since it is a plan not a measurement. Replace '<2% reaches live deployment (measured)' with '<2%' caption 'of everything we build clears the full validation pipeline' keyed where possible to archive stats; keep the measured date because that IS derivable from the archive. Optionally add a true figure: portfolio_candidates (21) 'qualified candidates in the pool today'.

State exactly what the widget is. If demo/burn-in: 'Live burn-in on Darwinex Zero, tracked on Myfxbook · early track record, independent verification in progress · updated live.' Do not call it a verified deployed portfolio until it is one. If the account is a demo, say 'demo/burn-in account' explicitly — a build-in-public audience rewards the honesty and punishes the discovery.

Keep verbatim, and add one sentence connecting it to the honest state: 'The live book is deliberately small while it burns in — new strategies join only through the book-build gate, and only the owner can enable live trading.' pages.current_message: Hero 'One engineer. A multi-agent quant engine.' An agent-roster table (Owner / Codex / Antigravity / Claude) and a 'How the factory runs' section. Accurate and well-toned.
problems: No business / monetization story. OWNER wants build-in-public so the fund, FTMO, MQL5 and copy-trading can be advertised plausibly. About is the natural home for an honest 'how this becomes a business' narrative and it is absent.

Link to the homepage roadmap / pipeline.

Standardise Claude's public role with FAQ. Use one label on both pages, e.g. 'Orchestration & governance AI — runs the backtest factory, enforces the Hard Rules, reviews evidence, and paces system spend.' Remove the FAQ's 'CTO-DevOps' or adopt it in both — but do not run two different titles.

Soften the video claim. Draft: 'Broad market research: mines quant books, papers and video transcripts, and mechanizes trading hypotheses into Strategy Cards.' (transcripts, not video analysis). If unsure, drop 'video' entirely.

pages.current_message: Accordion of 6 questions: what the 18-gate pipeline is (3 stages), how many survive (<2%, '~38 strategies'), prop-firm compatibility (DXZ + FTMO 2-Step), what HARSH stress Q06 is, how the multi-agent system works, why MT5/MQL5. Remove the 5-pip slippage / 3x spread / $20-lot figures entirely.

pages.current_message: Blog index 'Logbook — build in public.' 21 posts: strong educational pieces (Monte Carlo, walk-forward, deflated Sharpe, multi-seed, fixed-vs-percent risk, why-martingale, the 3-agent factory) plus strategy deep-dives (SM_124 Gotobi, SM_186 Asian drift) and two live-trading narratives (Implementation Gap, Psychology of Drawdown). Constraint: keep existing public naming, add no new internal identifiers.

Post dates are stale and inconsistent: newest is 'April 7, 2026' (today is 2026-09-05, ~5 months old); several posts read 'April 2026' with no day; commission-testing, drawdown-management and sm124-gotobi-story carry no date at all. Stale/missing dates undercut a 'build in public' logbook.
'How I Built a 15-Strategy Portfolio With Zero Correlation' / 'Portfolio V4' implies a completed live 15-strategy portfolio that does not exist yet.

proposed_changes.spec: Pull these from the index/sitemap until a real live record exists, OR rewrite them as explicitly hypothetical/educational (e.g. 'What the implementation gap will look like — and how we model it' framed as expectation, not observed live data) with a clear banner 'Illustrative — the live book is in burn-in; no funded-account results yet.' proposed_changes.section: Strategy deep-dives (SM_124, SM_186 posts + blog.html teasers)
proposed_changes.spec: Bring them under the disclosure posture. Remove every per-strategy Profit Factor (6.47, 4.57, 2.59) and 'X of 22 symbols passed' count, OR replace with gate-journey language that matches the archive: 'cleared baseline screening on a broad set of instruments and earned deeper validation' rather than 'PF 4.57 on GBPJPY'. If OWNER wants to spotlight a strategy family, do it through the mechanism (Gotobi settlement flows, Asian-session drift) and its gate journey — never a headline PF. Replace SM_124 / SM_186 / SM_221 with either the strategy family name (e.g. 'the Gotobi calendar family', 'the Asian-session drift family') or the public archive convention, and drop the internal V2.x / V4 / V5 version taxonomy in favour of plain language ('the current reset', 'the portfolio draft'). Keep the naming consistent with the public archive so a reader can cross-reference without hitting an internal code.

Give every post a real, consistent date (full YYYY date, one format) and add missing dates on commission-testing / drawdown-management / sm124-gotobi-story. If posts are genuinely older, keep true dates but consider a fresh cadence so the logbook does not look abandoned at 5 months stale.

Reframe from 'How I Built' (completed) to the method, not a claimed live portfolio: 'How we build toward a zero-correlation portfolio — family caps, symbol caps, pairwise correlation limits' presented as the Q15 construction rule, with an honest note that the first book is still being assembled (21 candidates in the pool).

problems: ROUTING — the 'kein Link funktioniert' root cause: every internal href is extensionless (/pipeline, /strategies, /blog-monte-carlo-explained) but the files are pipeline.html etc., and there is NO _redirects or netlify.toml in the publish dir. One phase vocabulary should be used everywhere.

Apply to the pipeline stage labels, the strategies-page stage chips, the FAQ pipeline answer, and any homepage teaser.
